name: Progress
description: A determinate progress bar with role=progressbar and exact value semantics
designIntent: Progress shows completion of a known-length task (uploads, installs, multi-step flows). It exposes exact values so assistive tech reports percentages, not just a moving bar.

props.name: max
props.description: Upper bound of the progress scale

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label announced by screen readers

examples.title: Step completion
examples.description: Progress through a finite set of steps

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Progress for indeterminate work
antiPatterns.explanation: When the duration is unknown, use Spinner or StreamingIndicator instead.

antiPatterns.title: Don't animate progress beyond its value
antiPatterns.explanation: Fabricating movement misleads users; only reflect real task progress.

accessibility.userRequirements: Provide an accessible label describing the task
Update the value as the task advances

guidelines: Name the task, not the bar

compositionRules.relationship: Use Skeleton for unknown-length content, Progress for known-length tasks
